Tooltip_PZC_Description: Nail the body to a wooden cross, a wall, a fence, a tree or any solid object. Move the cursor to pick the spot and press R to turn the body. A green outline means the spot works. The body keeps its clothes and belongings.
Tooltip_PZC_TakeDownDescription: Pull out the nails and lower the body to the ground. You get the nails back.
Tooltip_PZC_WoodenCross: Right-click it in your inventory to set it up. Once it stands, you can crucify a corpse on it.
Tooltip_PZC_MakeWoodenCross: Nail two planks into a cross tall enough to hang a body on.
